title: Singular adjective agreement in partitive
focus: Match an adjective to a singular partitive noun inside a phrase.

exercises.prompt: Complete “I am looking for a big car.” Etsin ____ autoa.
acceptedAnswers: isoa
exercises.explanation: An adjective directly describing this singular partitive noun also takes singular partitive. Agreement means matching the noun’s case and number. Keep iso and add -a: iso + a = isoa.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular adjective agreement in partitive: form or use confused

optionFeedback.isoa: An adjective directly describing this singular partitive noun also takes singular partitive. Agreement means matching the noun’s case and number. Keep iso and add -a: iso + a = isoa.
optionFeedback.iso: iso is not the required partitive form for this meaning. An adjective directly describing this singular partitive noun also takes singular partitive. Agreement means matching the noun’s case and number.
optionFeedback.isoja: isoja does not express the requested case and number here. Keep iso and add -a: iso + a = isoa.

exercises.prompt: Write “I am looking for a new car.” in Finnish. Frame: Etsin ____ autoa. Forms: uutta / uusi / uusia.
acceptedAnswers: Etsin uutta autoa.
Minä etsin uutta autoa.
exercises.explanation: An adjective directly describing this singular partitive noun also takes singular partitive. Agreement means matching the noun’s case and number. uusi uses uut- + -ta, written uutta; keep the long uu.
